verdict.rationale: Railway's own homepage describes a visual canvas that shows the entire stack and lets you change settings directly on it, with YAML optional. Auto-configuration further reduces the need for config files. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what can be edited on the canvas (e.g., networking, databases, scaling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of canvas editing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files

citations.quote: Craft on a visual canvas that makes your entire stack visible at a glance.
Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.
Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Railway reads your code and sets the right settings, automatically.
